title: Neighbor saw backyard lit up like a Hollywood set
summary: Mario Woods tells of Neighbor saw backyard lit up like a Hollywood set, about December 2017 at his home, Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: goes he goes your backyard was lit up like a Hollywood set or something

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who says he was abducted by aliens, describes a night in December 2017 at his home in Georgia. He says a neighbour later told him his backyard had been lit up like a Hollywood film set. For Woods, it is outside support that something strange happened at his house that night.
